item.title: Warmer days arrive Monday before mid-week precipitation
item.description: GILLETTE, Wyo. — Gillette will experience another cold February day before warmer days arrive Monday. Also arriving are more chances at precipitation and stronger winds. Today, which should be mostly cloudy before gradually clearing, will get as warm as 35 degrees. Winds will come in around 8-16 mph and will gust upwards of 24 mph.
